not_exported.detail: Fleet's built-in skills (presentation-builder, svg-builder, mermaid-diagram-builder, generate-skill, fleet-guide and others) ship with Fleet's runtime. The exported agent doesn't have them.

left_behind: Conversations: past threads stay in Fleet. The deployment starts with none.
Sharing: people you shared the agent with in Fleet don't get access to the deployment.
Credentials: saved logins don't carry over. Each user signs in again the first time a tool needs it.
Traces: the deployment traces to a new LangSmith project. Past traces stay in the Fleet agent's project.

connections.summary: The agent owns this connection to https://mcp.notion.com/mcp, and a connection the agent owns can only be created once the deployment exists, so the server is commented out in `tools/mcp.py`.
steps: Run `mda connections create notion --mcp https://mcp.notion.com/mcp --authorize` and sign in to the account every caller shares

after_first_deploy: notion: run `mda connections create notion --mcp https://mcp.notion.com/mcp --authorize` and sign in to the account every caller shares
Then uncomment those servers in tools/mcp and run `mda deploy` again
memory: `memory.py` gives the agent its own memory in `memories/agent/`. It starts empty, and the agent adds to it as it learns.
